import sys, json, importlib.util
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen, gen2
def load(path,name):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m
ref=load('/workspace/tmp/ref.py','refm')
dec=Counter(); st=Counter(); extra=Counter()
for seed in range(300):
    doc=(gen2 if seed%2 else gen).gen(seed)
    cfg,mdl,conns,pkts=ref.check(doc)
    out=ref.replay(cfg,mdl,conns,pkts)
    for p in out['packets']: dec[p['decision']]+=1
    for j in out['jobs']: st[j['status']]+=1
    extra['f1nonzero'] += sum(1 for s in ('dev','eval') if out['reports'][s]['macro_f1']!=[0,1])
    extra['preds'] += sum(1 for c in out['connections'] if c['prediction'] is not None)
print(dec); print(st); print(extra)
EOF
